reason: I already ask ChatGPT what to do and then make the trades myself, and my broker is rolling out its own AI for free. I don't see why I'd pay another monthly fee for a cartoon pet to do something I can already do without paying.
objection: It's a new app with no real-money account yet and no price, and I'd be letting it move my actual savings. At 55 with less than $20k invested, I can't afford to experiment, and I'm not adding a fourth subscription for something my broker gives me free.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked inside the broker account I already have and cost nothing extra, with a few months of demo results showing it actually did better than what I do by hand.
